title: Covariance equals variance
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $f:\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$. The covariance of $f$ with itself under the product distribution with one-coordinate law $\pi$ equals the variance of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
